items.label: Larger Organizer for Maximum Efficiency
items.value: This under sink organizer, measuring 11.8"W x 15.9"D x (13.8"-16.9")H, providing more capacity for storing taller bottles, cleaning supplies and other essentials.Before purchasing, please double-check your cabinet dimensions to ensure this under cabinet organizer fits properly.

items.label: Advanced Stability for Heavy Loads
items.value: With 4 large suction cups and 2 nano adhesive films, this under sink organizers and storage system provides exceptional stability, holding up to 50 lbs effortlessly. Its smooth pull-out design ensures no wobbling, making it the perfect kitchen sink organizer for secure and easy access.

items.label: Thicker, Heavier Materials for Stability
items.value: This under the sink organizer is built with thicker, heavier steel and a 1-inch reinforced frame, ensuring outstanding durability and stability. Its robust, weighted design prevents wobbling, making it the perfect kitchen cabinet organizer for heavy-duty and long-term storage use.

items.label: 2-Tier Sliding Design for Easy Access
items.value: This pantry organizers and storage system features a smooth 2-tier sliding design, allowing you to easily reach items stored at the back without bending or kneeling. Perfect for organizing cleaning supplies or toiletries, it’s also a great solution for bathroom organizers and storage, ensuring everything is within reach.

items.label: Adjustable Heights for Flexible Storage
items.value: With 5 height settings, this organizer adapts to items of different sizes, from tall bottles to compact containers. Ideal for home and kitchen use, it also works great as closet organizers and storage, providing efficient organization and storage in any cabinet or closet.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: 5 Adjustable Heights for Flexible Storage, Durable and Thickened Carbon Steel Frame, Elegant Wooden Handles for Comfortable Grip, Firm Suction Cups and Nano Adhesive Films for for Enhanced Stability, Practical and Efficient 2-Tier Design
